step: B lifecycle: K for the intent lapse
rule: An intent lapses at whichever comes first: 3 scene breaks after its last affirmation (INTENT_LAPSE_SCENES) or K boundaries (INTENT_LAPSE_BOUNDARIES). K = 3 x the median boundaries per scene in the D1 corpus (v2.6 plan 02).
why: The D1 corpus did not exist when plan 06 was built. 8 is a placeholder, not a measurement. D1 sets it.
command: node scripts/debug/so-intent-k.mts measure --corpus <D1 corpus id> <persisted runtime or chat_metadata JSON files...> [--write]
toFix: Run the command over the D1 corpus. Without --write it prints the median and K. With --write it rewrites MEDIAN_BOUNDARIES_PER_SCENE in src/memory/innerVoice.ts, sets INTENT_LAPSE_K_PROVISIONAL = false, and records corpus, scenes, chats and median here under measured. The jest case 'K and its recipe agree' fails if the constant and this file disagree.
